---
title: Scales
---

## Functions

- [`scale-colour-continuous`](scale-colour-continuous.qmd) - Continuous colour scale mapping a numeric column to stroke colours.
- [`scale-colour-discrete`](scale-colour-discrete.qmd) - Discrete colour scale mapping categorical levels to stroke colours.
- [`scale-colour-manual`](scale-colour-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete colour scale: supply the colour array directly.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-b`](scale-colour-viridis-b.qmd) - Binned viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-c`](scale-colour-viridis-c.qmd) - Continuous viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-d`](scale-colour-viridis-d.qmd) - Discrete viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-fill-continuous`](scale-fill-continuous.qmd) - Continuous fill scale mapping a numeric column to fill colours.
- [`scale-fill-discrete`](scale-fill-discrete.qmd) - Discrete fill scale mapping categorical levels to fill colours.
- [`scale-fill-manual`](scale-fill-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete fill scale: supply the colour array directly.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-b`](scale-fill-viridis-b.qmd) - Binned viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-c`](scale-fill-viridis-c.qmd) - Continuous viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-d`](scale-fill-viridis-d.qmd) - Discrete viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-linetype`](scale-linetype.qmd) - Discrete linetype scale: maps levels to dash-pattern keywords.
- [`scale-linetype-manual`](scale-linetype-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete linetype scale: supply the dash-keyword array directly.
- [`scale-shape`](scale-shape.qmd) - Discrete shape scale: maps levels to marker-shape keywords.
- [`scale-shape-manual`](scale-shape-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete shape scale: supply the shape-keyword array directly.
- [`scale-size-continuous`](scale-size-continuous.qmd) - Continuous size scale mapping a numeric column to a size range.
- [`scale-x-continuous`](scale-x-continuous.qmd) - Continuous x scale: axis title, limits, breaks, labels, and transformation.
- [`scale-x-discrete`](scale-x-discrete.qmd) - Discrete x scale: axis title, level ordering, and tick labels.
- [`scale-y-continuous`](scale-y-continuous.qmd) - Continuous y scale: axis title, limits, breaks, labels, and transformation.
- [`scale-y-discrete`](scale-y-discrete.qmd) - Discrete y scale: axis title, level ordering, and tick labels.
